The opening "ALLIGATORS BRNO" title now stays on screen one second longer: 84 frames, up from 54.

I didn't just stretch the title, because then it would have run over the shaking tackle shot and the white flash. Instead the opening shot under it is also one second longer (84 frames, up from 54). Everything after it starts 30 frames later, so the rest of the cut keeps the same pacing. The video is now 24.8s instead of 23.8s. I also changed "~24s" to "~25s" in the canvas header comment and the artboard subtitle.

The check passed and the canvas loads. The screenshot only shows the still image before playback starts (the "RYCHLOST" title over the speed lines), not the opening, so I haven't seen the longer title on screen. Play the first few seconds to confirm it looks right.
